title: Private status unlikely benchmark evidence
objective: Check in a reproducible benchmark evidence report for the private-status-unlikely optimization experiment at commit 59927bb, including frozen replay measurements, ratios, pooled geometric mean, code sizes, provenance commits, and artifact hashes

oracles: Authoritative raw benchmark JSON and generated workload artifacts

handoff.summary: Added concise Markdown and machine-readable JSON evidence for compiler candidate 59927bb against the frozen Stage G catalog. The report preserves both raw-run hashes, all 14 paired ratios, pooled geometric means, semantic replay outcomes, source/compiler identities, generated artifact hashes, code sizes, exact replay commands, and the missing environment-identity limitation.
risks: The timing is shared-host diagnostic evidence. The raw records did not capture hostname, OS, CPU, Node, C compiler, linker, or binutils identities, so the original environment cannot be reconstructed.

pnpm test:compiler is not green on the 696c0bb experiment base: fixtures encounter the pre-existing undefined $rho$sigma$py$Any emission, and native extension fixtures cannot load the optional unbuilt FLINT addon. The report changes no compiler or runtime source.
next_steps: Integrate the evidence alongside compiler commit 59927bb and retain its diagnostic-only qualification.
Repair the experiment branch's RealNumberBuffer type emission and provision optional native fixtures before expecting its full compiler suite to pass.
